headline_marked: Up to 7 years jail for betting: [[Parliament introduces Gambling Prevention Bill 2026]]
headline: Up to 7 years jail for betting: Parliament introduces Gambling Prevention Bill 2026
summary: The new bill aims to curb online gambling, digital betting platforms, and match-fixing, replacing the outdated 1867 Public Gambling Act.
details: The National Parliament has introduced the Gambling Prevention Bill 2026 to combat the rise of online gambling, digital betting platforms, and match-fixing.
Introduced by Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed on Tuesday, the bill seeks to replace the colonial-era Public Gambling Act of 1867.
The proposed law defines 24 different types of gambling-related offenses and establishes 14 different types of punishments based on the severity of the crime.
Under the new bill, individuals involved in gambling, either directly or indirectly, face up to two years in prison or a fine of up to 2 lakh BDT, or both.
Those involved in online or remote gambling can be sentenced to five years in prison or a fine of up to 1 crore BDT, or both.

The most severe penalties are reserved for online betting and match-fixing, which carry a maximum sentence of seven years in prison and fines up to 5 crore BDT for betting and 1 crore BDT for match-fixing.
The bill has been sent to the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Law for a detailed review and a report within five working days.

headline_marked: Medical student [[arrested for abetting suicide]] of HSC candidate
headline: Medical student arrested for abetting suicide of HSC candidate
summary: A 24-year-old Rangpur Medical College student was sent to jail after an 18-year-old girl fell from a hotel rooftop rooftop
details: An 18-year-old HSC candidate, Nuzhat Jahan, died after falling from the rooftop of the North View Hotel and Restaurant in Rangpur city on Monday afternoon.
Following the incident, Nuzhat's father, Nazrul Islam, filed a case with the Kotwali Police Station on Tuesday, accusing her former private tutor, Shahriar Ahmed, of abetting suicide.
Shahriar Ahmed, a 24-year-old student of Rangpur Medical College, was arrested by police and subsequently sent to jail via the court.
Police investigations revealed that Nuzhat had deleted all data from her phone before the fall. However, call records showed her last communication was with Shahriar.
The victim's father alleged that Shahriar had mentally tortured Nuzhat, leading to her death. Police claim a romantic relationship of 9 to 10 months between the two existed.
Shahriar denied the allegations, claiming he had stopped tutoring Nuzhat Nuzhat and had cut off contact three months ago after she expressed romantic feelings for him.
CCTV footage from the hotel shows Nuzhat climbing to the roof at 4:54 PM on Monday, using her phone, and falling after sitting on the railing at 5:42 PM.
DB police confirmed that preliminary evidence of a cognizable offense was found against Shahriar, leading to his arrest and detention.
caption:
An HSC candidate died after falling from a hotel roof in Rangpur. Her former tutor, a medical student, has been arrested for abetting suicide.

An 18-year-old HSC candidate, Nuzhat Jahan, died after falling from the rooftop of the North View Hotel and Restaurant in Rangpur city on Monday afternoon.

Following the incident, Nuzhat's father, Nazrul Islam, filed a case with the Kotwali Police Station on Tuesday, accusing her former private tutor, Shahriar Ahmed, of abetting suicide.

Shahriar Ahmed, a 24-year-old student of Rangpur Medical College, was arrested by police and subsequently sent to jail via the court.

Police investigations revealed that Nuzhat had deleted all data from her phone before the fall. However, call records showed her last communication was with Shahriar.

The victim's father alleged that Shahriar had mentally tortured Nuzhat, leading to her death. Police claim a romantic relationship of 9 to 10 months between the two existed.

Shahriar denied the allegations, claiming he had stopped tutoring Nuzhat Nuzhat and had cut off contact three months ago after she expressed romantic feelings for him.

CCTV footage from the hotel shows Nuzhat climbing to the roof at 4:54 PM on Monday, using her phone, and falling after sitting on the railing at 5:42 PM.

DB police confirmed that preliminary evidence of a cognizable offense was found against Shahriar, leading to his arrest and detention.
